हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/pwxXcN
show.description:
This show feels real because it speaks the language of Gen Z's struggles with unstable jobs, family pressure, loans, broken dreams, and emotional loneliness.
The hero isn’t powerful or privileged; he’s someone who keeps trying, failing, and still doesn’t give up.
Every life he lives reflects problems common people face but never talk about openly.
It’s not fantasy for the elite—it’s hope, pain, and survival for the everyday Indian.
